description: Characterization (golden) baseline for expression evaluation - pins representative SELECT <expr> results so ANTLR-builder regressions surface as value changes: arithmetic precedence and left-associativity (10 - 4 - 2 = 4), string concat, comparisons, logical operators, LIKE, prefix NOT binding looser than comparison (NOT 1 = 2 is true), row-constructor tuple IN, BETWEEN/LIKE followed by top-level AND/OR parsing as (predicate) AND rest, and a boolean AND expression projected from a table without aggregation. Deliberately an own-engine golden pin (the Java class ran embedded-only, never on the live surface). Converted 1:1 from expressions/ExpressionCharacterizationTest (now retired).
